name: @contractor/native-sync-feed
description: Authorized commit-safe change feed (M03-T04): server tenant change log with commit-order cursor semantics, tenant/permission authorization, fail-closed redaction, incremental byte-bounded pulls, durable consumer checkpoints with idempotent replay, and command receipts with financial retention + compaction. Built on the M00-ratified Server-Mediated Hybrid Change-Feed (ADR-0011). Pilot domain: daily report / field submission. Evidence runs against real SQLite (node:sqlite).
